## CROBOT Project - Navigation & Layout Components Summary

I've thoroughly explored the CROBOT project and identified all sidebar, header, topbar, and navigation components. Here's the complete breakdown:

---

### **FILE PATHS AND STRUCTURE**

#### **MAIN APP LAYOUT COMPONENTS:**
1. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/App.tsx` - Root routing configuration
2. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/AppLayout.tsx` - User app layout wrapper
3. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/AdminLayout.tsx` - Admin panel layout wrapper
4. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx` - User app sidebar
5. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/TopBar.tsx` - User app topbar/header
6. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/NavLink.tsx` - Navigation link wrapper
7. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/shared/PageHeader.tsx` - Page header component
8. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx` - Auth guard
9. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/AdminRoute.tsx` - Admin auth guard

#### **UI COMPONENT PRIMITIVES:**
10. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx` - Shadcn sidebar component system
11. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` - Dropdown menu component
12. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/ui/navigation-menu.tsx` - Navigation menu component

---

### **COMPONENT DETAILS**

#### **1. AppLayout.tsx (User App Layout Wrapper)**
**Purpose:** Main layout wrapper for authenticated user app pages
**Children Components:** AppSidebar + TopBar
**Features:**
- Sidebar state management via cookie (`sidebar:state`)
- Full-height flex layout
- Main content area with padding
- Outlet for page content

#### **2. AdminLayout.tsx (Admin Panel Layout Wrapper)**
**Purpose:** Dedicated layout for admin panel with collapsible sidebar
**Key Features:**
- Collapsible sidebar (60px when collapsed, 240px when expanded)
- Session storage-based collapse state (`admin:sidebar`)
- Admin navigation menu with 9 items:
  - Dashboard
  - Users
  - Scans
  - Billing
  - System
  - Feature Flags
  - Integrations
  - Support
  - Audit Log
- "Back to App" link in sidebar
- Admin badge in top header
- User identity card in sidebar footer
- Collapse/expand toggle button
- Top header with breadcrumb navigation
- Admin user dropdown menu in top right

**Structure:**
```
<div> (h-screen flex overflow-hidden)
  ├── <aside> (sidebar - 240px or 60px)
  │   ├── Header (logo + admin label)
  │   ├── Nav (9 items + separator + back link)
  │   └── Footer (user avatar, role, collapse button)
  └── <div> (main content)
      ├── <header> (top bar with breadcrumb + user dropdown)
      └── <main> (page outlet)
```

#### **3. AppSidebar.tsx (User App Sidebar)**
**Purpose:** Main sidebar for user dashboard application
**Collapsible:** Yes (using `useSidebar` hook)
**Navigation Items (6 items):**
- Dashboard
- New Scan
- My Reports
- AI Agents (feature flag gated: `agent_hub_enabled`)
- Integrations (feature flag gated: `integrations_enabled`)
- Settings

**Footer Elements:**
- Admin Panel shortcut (only for admin/super_admin roles)
- Scan usage indicator with progress bar
- Plan badge (Free/Pro/Agency)
- Upgrade Plan button (not shown for agency plan)
- Separator
- Feature flag controlled visibility

**Styling Notes:**
- Uses Tailwind classes with `bg-sidebar`, `sidebar-foreground`, `sidebar-primary`
- Active state indicator: left accent bar (2px) with primary color
- Hover effects on nav items

#### **4. TopBar.tsx (User App Header/Topbar)**
**Purpose:** Top header/navigation bar for user app
**Height:** 60px
**Left Section:**
- Sidebar toggle trigger
- Breadcrumb navigation:

#### **5. NavLink.tsx (Navigation Link Wrapper)**
**Purpose:** Custom NavLink component extending React Router's NavLink
**Props:**
- `className` - Base CSS classes
- `activeClassName` - Classes applied when link is active
- `pendingClassName` - Classes applied when navigation is pending
- All React Router NavLink props

#### **6. shared/PageHeader.tsx (Page Header Component)**
**Purpose:** Reusable page header for content sections
**Props:**
- `title` - Main heading text (required)
- `description` - Optional subtitle/description
- `children` - Optional action buttons/controls
- `className` - Additional CSS classes

**Layout:** Responsive flex (column on mobile, row on desktop)

#### **7. ProtectedRoute.tsx (Auth Guard)**
**Purpose:** Wrapper for protected user app routes
**Behavior:**
- Shows loading spinner while auth state resolves
- Redirects unauthenticated users to /login
- Renders Outlet for authenticated users

#### **8. AdminRoute.tsx (Admin Auth Guard)**
**Purpose:** Wrapper for admin-only routes
**Behavior:**
- Checks if user has `admin` or `super_admin` role
- Shows loading spinner during auth resolution
- Shows error toast if non-admin tries to access
- Redirects non-admin users to /dashboard
- Renders Outlet for admin users

### **KEY FEATURES & PATTERNS**

1. **Responsive Design:**
   - Mobile: Sidebar becomes offcanvas sheet
   - Desktop: Fixed sidebar with icon collapse mode
   - Breadcrumb hides secondary text on mobile

2. **State Management:**
   - Sidebar state: Cookie (`sidebar:state`)
   - Admin sidebar collapse: Session storage (`admin:sidebar`)
   - Feature flags: Context hooks

3. **Accessibility:**
   - ARIA labels on toggle buttons
   - Focus states on interactive elements
   - Keyboard shortcut for sidebar (Ctrl/Cmd+B)
   - Sr-only (screen reader only) text

4. **User Context:**
   - Display full name + initials
   - Show role (admin/super_admin/user)

   - Plan badge on user menu

5. **Admin Features:**
   - Role-based access control
   - Breadcrumb navigation
   - Admin badge indicator
   - Dedicated admin sidebar with all management sections
   - Toast notifications for access denied
